    def orbit(i,j): return [grid[i][j],grid[i][w-1-j],grid[h-1-i][j],grid[h-1-i][w-1-j]]
    def clean(i,j): return len(set(orbit(i,j)))==1
    from collections import Counter,defaultdict
    total=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    unc=defaultdict(int)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if not clean(i,j): unc[grid[i][j]]+=1
    cands=[(n,c) for c,n in total.items() if n==unc.get(c,0) and n>0]
    if not cands: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    _,c=max(cands)
